description:
Is the all-new Chinese Audi E7X better than the German Audi Q8?

Get 20% off Car Vertical using code Carwow: https://www.carvertical.com/carwow

Mat’s got his hands on the all-new Audi E7X. 

However, this is no ordinary Audi! It’s been built exclusively for the Chinese market, so we won’t see it on sale in the UK, Europe or the USA! But why is that?

Audi is well aware that those looking to purchase a car in China are much more likely to buy something that is home-grown, rather than a German export. As a result, the E7X is a joint venture between Audi and SAIC, with Audi’s traditional four-ring logo dropped in favour of capitalised AUDI lettering instead. 

The question is, what else has changed? Let’s take a closer look… 

Starting with the design, although the size is relatively similar to an Audi Q8, there is almost nothing else that distinguishes it as an Audi. Whereas all German manufacturers' cars will follow some of the same design cues, if you were to remove the AUDI badging
title: Why is this 680hp Audi BANNED from Europe?
